responseMessageContents.text:
The user seems to be asking me to take them directly to where they can provide the token, likely a typo for "llévame" in Spanish. I'll respond briefly and open the secure secrets widget requesting GITHUB_TOKEN.

Since GITHUB_TOKEN already exists but was revoked, I need to force the request so it gets replaced. I'll keep my message short and put the widget call at the end, without requesting the public variant since this is a private secret.

Perfecto — aquí va el canal seguro directo.

Pega el token nuevo aquí abajo (no en el chat). Reemplaza el valor revocado de `GITHUB_TOKEN`:

**Recordatorio:** antes de que sirva, hay que correr `git rm -r --cached .rork/history` — si no, el escáner de GitHub lo revoca igual que a los tres anteriores.
